title: Hot Cocoa
description: Small pack including some fixes and Vanilla-esque additions for optimal cozy gaming with friends and loved ones <3
body:
Simple modpack in development, focusing on casual gameplay and not deadly exploration.
Cute animals, cottagecore decorations and a sprinkle of adventure!

Some of the more popular mods include
